413-1981-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-4716.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

141-1070-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-3967.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha, Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2021-2060-3334-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

129-1409-3755-7730.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4053-5499-7730--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5499-7730--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7726.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1608-4050-4853-7452.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Triplicate Titan, adding {B}.
When Triplicate Titan dies, it and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Triplicate Titan trigger, creating three creature tokens.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Essence.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {1}{G}.
When the creatures die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice, untapping two artifacts.
Activate Cauldron of Essence by paying {1}{B}{G}, tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, and Dross Scorpion triggers if the creature was an artifact.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, if applicable, untapping an artifact.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence ability from step 7, returning Triplicate Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4826-5702-7401.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
4826-5702-7401.notablePrerequisites: At least half of the basic lands in your library are Forests.
4826-5702-7401.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
When the Springbloom Druid token enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a land, then search your library for a basic Forest and another basic land and put them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos 
When the basic lands enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate both lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
Repeat from step 3 until your library contains no basic lands.
4826-5702-7401.notes: You can perform this combo if half the basic lands in your library aren't Forests, but you won't be able to grab all basic lands unless you supplement {G} to compensate. While you will put all basic lands onto the battlefield, you'll have to sacrifice half of them to continue the combo. This won't affect how many landfall triggers, ETB triggers and creature tokens you get however.

2525-3763-6749-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2525-3763-6749-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1856-3490-4050-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1856-3490-4050-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing Doom Weaver and the Servo.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-2544-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Repeat.
2092-2544-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can either use Steelswarm Operator's first ability or untap other artifacts you control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

4785-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2933-4013-4927-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

4050-5189-5332.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4050-5189-5332.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Carmen's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4871-5147-6291.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

185-2020-4276-4293.notablePrerequisites:
Vadrik has power 3 or greater.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
185-2020-4276-4293.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {U}, returning Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {R}, returning Runic Repetition from your graveyard to your hand and exiling Mystic Retrieval.
Cast Runic Repetition by paying {U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}{U}{U}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1698-2034-2577-3260.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
1698-2034-2577-3260.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B} or 2 life due to K'rrik.
K'rrik triggers, as well as each creature you control's extort ability.
Resolve the first K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay {W/B} or 2 life due to K'rrik, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1560-2232-3643.notablePrerequisites:
Two additional nonartifact green creature cards in hand that can be cast for {G}.
You have at least 3 life.
1560-2232-3643.description:
Cast a green creature spell by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Vigor and Silverback Elder each trigger.
Resolve the Silverback Elder trigger, gaining 4 life.
Resolve the Defiler of Vigor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the creature spell.
Cloudstone Curio triggers; if the other creature is on the battlefield, return it to your hand; otherwise choose not to return anything.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat any number of times again, this time choosing either of Silverback Elder's other modes.

2104-3554-4130.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Mastermind's Acquisition by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Mastermind's Acquisition and Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

822-4241-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-4241-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-4241-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
